title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Australian 40-year economic outlook recognizes ‘AI revolution,’ omits crypto
summary: Treasury named AI among five major transitions expected to reshape Australia’s economy, while Coinbase says the report overlooks the digital financial infrastructure AI agents could eventually need.

title: Trueo prediction market moves from Base to Ethereum
summary: Trueo said Base was the right choice when it launched, as Ethereum gas fees were higher, but said mainnet now offers greater integration potential.

title: Kakao Pay, KakaoBank to explore stablecoin opportunities with Fireblocks
summary: Kakao Pay and KakaoBank are exploring digital asset opportunities with Fireblocks, including infrastructure for stablecoins.

title: Manhattan US Attorney leading probe into Binance’s Iran compliance: Bloomberg
summary: The investigation is reportedly examining whether Binance knowingly allowed trading that violated US sanctions on Iran, months after reports first revealed a Justice Department probe.

title: Saudi Arabia exits China-backed mBridge CBDC project: FT
summary: Saudi Arabia has left mBridge, a cross-border CBDC platform that has drawn scrutiny from US policymakers, according to the Financial Times.

title: Ondo lets institutions convert stocks directly into tokenized shares
summary: Ondo’s new in-kind conversion system allows approved institutions to mint and redeem tokenized stocks and ETFs using the underlying securities instead of cash.

title: Crypto PAC to spend $30M opposing Sherrod Brown in Ohio, again
summary: The digital asset-aligned PAC joined other groups to spend more than a combined $300 million in the 2024 Ohio Senate race, resulting in Sherrod Brown’s loss to Bernie Moreno.

title: Circle launches Bitcoin-backed USDC borrowing for institutional clients
summary: Circle is bringing Bitcoin-backed borrowing to institutional clients, allowing them to tap BTC holdings for USDC liquidity without selling their Bitcoin.

title: Bitcoin price tags $86K as analysis sees crypto in ‘new bull market’
summary: Bitcoin crossed the $86,000 mark for the first time since late January as falling oil prices and concerns over supply lifted US stocks.
